Animate a first frame with MiniMax H3, optionally adding a last frame for endpoint control, with synchronized stereo audio. LightX2V 768p eight-step adapter with conservative Sol attention.

For a shot that moves from one image to another, pass input_images=[first_frame, last_frame]; the video opens on the first image and ends on the last. With one image it animates forward from that frame. To continue an existing video, use minimax-h3-r2v-turbo instead: starting from its last frame here carries neither its motion nor its voice. Describe the motion and sound that carry the first frame to the last.
Use the visible <Picture N>, <Video N>, and <Audio N> tags to assign identity, style, motion, camera, or voice references.
Video duration in seconds; H3 snaps this to its valid 24 fps frame grid.
Include H3 generated stereo audio in the output video.
Diffusion-model precision. INT8 ConvRot is the default; FP8 is the quality-reference alternative.
Higher values trade detail for speed. 1.0 is the tested Sol setting.
Fraction of the denoising schedule before Sol begins; earlier steps use dense attention.
Fraction of the denoising schedule where Sol ends; later steps use dense attention.

Pin stills or short clips at exact times in the output. A still at 0 is the first frame; a still with `at` equal to the duration is the last frame. A clip pinned with its sound carries that picture and audio into the output from where it lands, so the last second of an earlier take pinned at 0 continues it. Pinned images are not shown to the prompt; to name one as <Picture N>, also pass it in input_images.
